properties.description:
`relation_candidates` — read-only, index-free ranking of what a node might relate to, plus the `link-ideas` skill and command that drive the backlog, plus the `what_next` fix that stops an idea contradicting settled intent from scoring zero.

TWO SIGNALS: a shared neighbour (both nodes relate to some third node) and distinctive shared terms (IDF-weighted across the pool, so words true of everything count for nothing). Structural presence is the PRIMARY SORT KEY, not a multiplier — an asserted edge outranks a vocabulary coincidence categorically.

REFUSALS ARE THE DESIGN: it never writes and never proposes an edge; a candidate whose reason cannot be stated is dropped rather than offered; nodes already related are excluded from the ranking and returned in `already_related`; and an empty answer names which of three empties it is.

Lives in its own module rather than in `relate.rs`, whose docs reserve suggestion for "the dedup guard's job and the skill's" and forbid a machine proposing edges there.
properties.name: Offer an unlinked idea its likely neighbours, with the walk that produced each
